1: Compassion shown to someone in need; the Greek Old Testament uses it for Hebrew chesed, steadfast love.
The New Testament's main word for love; it fills 1 Corinthians 13 and defines God in 1 John 4:8.
Literally 'of the age': the life of the age to come, which begins now.
Sometimes simply the body, but in Paul often human nature turned away from God.
